reason: I would let it run on the free 30, but a café goes through 30 receipts in a week or two, and that is too short to know if my staff will keep sending properly or my admin will just go back to her Excel. I don't start a monthly bill for something we might drop after two weeks.
objection: After the free part ends, will my people really keep using it, or will I be paying every month for a bot while my admin still types everything in on Friday?
would_change_my_mind: A full free month, so I can see one whole month of the café in the sheet with my admin not typing anything, before I put in a card.
